title: Lake Tahoe Evening Dinner Cruise
includes: Gratuity Pay of 20% for 8 or more People - Adult (charged on site) (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Please plan to arrive at the boat dock to check in 30 minutes prior to your departure
If using our complimentary shuttle service, please plan additional time for pickup and drop off. Please see Meeting & pickup section for specific times from each location.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Don't miss this one-of-a-kind experience aboard the largest cruising vessel in South Lake Tahoe!

Enjoy fabulous dining as you cruise against a backdrop of astonishing views over Emerald Bay. Please contact us no less than 24 hours prior to departure to choose one of the below delicious main courses:

- Cowboy Ribeye served with a peppercorn demi, creamy mashed potatoes and steamed broccolini

- Airline Roasted chicken with a chimichurri drizzle, creamy mashed potatoes and steamed broccolini

- Broiled seasoned salmon with a citronette sauce, cheesy polenta and steamed broccolini

- Mushroom Ragu served with Rice Pilaf and steamed broccolini

After dinner, experience the beauty of Lake Tahoe from outside, or relax and enjoy the live music with our climate controlled indoor seating. Full bar service is available for purchase throughout your adventure.

Go forth and dine in style as you cruise into the sunset beauty of Lake Tahoe!
